name: Mysterious Bartender
source:
The mysterious owner of a bar called "ROAD59" that's located in the bustling downtown area of Tenkai District.

For the people of Tenkai District, he's a source of juice gossip, reliable information and alcohol.

[Modified from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595800/ROAD59_A_Yakuzas_Last_Stand/]Steam page[/url]]
